trigger: Full-pool financing sweep undertaken ahead of building the real HistoricalEvent registry and running the actual select_frozen_cohort(seed=100100) freeze. Discovered that only 11 of the 152 universe-PASS candidates had both financing and single-asset status fully resolved - all prior financing work targeted specific candidates (seed-selected or negative-event candidates) rather than sweeping the full pool. Since HistoricalEvent.financing_t_minus_90_to_t_plus_30 is a required boolean with no PENDING state, every candidate considered for registry inclusion needs a genuine, evidenced determination.
qualification_rule: Count only actual issuer equity or equity-linked dilution occurring from T-90 through T+30. Theoretical shelf or ATM registration capacity without actual issuance is not sufficient.
method: Bulk SEC EDGAR submissions API sweep (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{10digit}.json, with the older paginated archive file fetched whenever the recent-filings array did not reach back far enough to cover a candidate's T-90 window) for 424B1/424B2/424B3/424B4/424B5, S-1, S-1/A, S-3, and S-3/A filings, plus 8-K filings whose reported Item list includes 3.02 (Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities, the standard PIPE-disclosure item), filtered to each candidate's own T-90-to-T+30 window. Coverage was independently verified: for every candidate in this batch, the earliest filing date returned by the sweep (recent array, or the paginated older-filings archive where needed) precedes that candidate's window_start, so no filing in the window could have been missed.
